english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for food that has not been cooked.

exampleSentences.english: This fish is still raw, so don’t eat it yet.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢塊魚仲生㗎，唔好食住。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 faai3 jyu4 zung6 saang1 gaa3 m4 hou2 sik6 zyu6

english.note: Use this specifically for meat cooked very lightly and still red inside.

exampleSentences.english: I want the steak rare, with the inside still red.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我要塊扒生啲，入面仲紅先好食。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 faai3 paa4 saang1 di1 jap6 min6 zung6 hung4 sin1 hou2 sik6
